results.rationale: A group of balloons is added floating high above the bed instead of a single regular-air balloon resting on the floor. This contradicts the supplied physical expectation. The room layout remains recognizable but carved wall-panel details and bedding folds are noticeably altered. The edited room and balloon surfaces are visually coherent with natural lighting and no obvious structural artifacts.

The sea becomes glossy dark patches, attempting an oil-covered surface, but lacks the requested rainbow sheen and instead resembles polygonal cracked sheets. Sky and horizon remain consistent. The broad perspective and reflections are coherent; the sharply segmented surface texture is a minor naturalness issue.
